verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
          ततो दुर्योधनो राजा मोहात् प्रत्यागतस्तदा ।  शरवर्षैः पुनर्भीमं प्रत्यवारयदच्युतम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Thereafter king king Duryodhana, having regained his senses, once more opposed the invincible Bhima with a shower of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: एकीभूतास्ततश्चैव तव पुत्रा महारथाः ।  समेत्य समरे भीमं योधयामासुरुद्यताः ॥२॥
verses.english: Once more uniting together, your sons, all mighty car-warrior, encountering Bhima in battle, begin to fight with him in all earnestness.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनोऽपि समरे संप्राप्य स्वरथं पुनः ।  समारुह्य महाबाहुर्ययौ येन तवात्मजः ॥३॥
verses.english: The mighty-armed Bhimasena also approaching his chariot mounted on it, and proceeded to that pare of the filed where your sons were.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य च महावेगं परासुकरणं दृढम् ।  सज्जं शरासनं संख्ये शरैर्विव्याध ते सुतम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Taking up a wonderfully tough bow endued with great energy, capable of depriving the enemy of his life, and diversely variegated, he (Bhima) began to pierce your sons with innumerable shafts in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।  नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन भृशं मर्मण्यताडयत् ॥५॥
verses.english: Then king Duryodhana shortly wounded the mighty Bhima in his very vital parts with a Naracha of exceeding sharpness.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासस्तव पुत्रेण धन्विना ।  क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो वेगेनाक्षिप्य कार्मुकम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Thus deeply pierced by your son, that fierce bow-man, with eyes red in rage and out of fury drawing his bow-string fiercely.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ।  स तत्र शुशुभे राजा शिखरैर्गिरिराडिव ॥७॥
verses.english: Pierced Duryodhana on this two arms and breast, with three arrows; but O king, thus struck the latter wavered not, like a monarch of mountains.

verses.sanskrit: तौ दृष्ट्वा समरे क्रुद्धौ विनिघ्नन्तौ परस्परम् ।  दुर्योधनानुजाः सर्वे शूराः संत्यक्तजीविताः ॥८॥
verses.english: Beholding those two enraged heroes strike one another in battle, the younger brothers of Duryodhana, all of whom were ready to lay down lives their in battle.

verses.sanskrit: संस्मृत्य मन्त्रितं पूर्वं निग्रहे भीमकर्मणः ।  निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा निग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रमुः ॥९॥
verses.english: Bearing in mind their pre-concerted plan of afflicting Bhima of fierce deeds, began with an earnest determination, to strike him (from all sides).

verses.sanskrit: तानापतत एवाजौ भीमसेनो महाबलः ।  प्रत्युद्ययौ महाराज गजः प्रतिगजानिव ॥१०॥
verses.english: Then the highly powerful Bhima beholding them make towards himself in battle, O monarch, rushed against them like an elephants encountering his compeers.

verses.sanskrit: भृशं क्रुद्धश्च तेजस्वी नाराचेन समर्पयत् ।  चित्रसेनं महाराज तव पुत्रं महायशाः ॥११॥
verses.english: Then excited to fury, that hero endued with great fame and energy, afflicted your son Chitrasena, O monarch, with a long shaft.

verses.sanskrit: तथेतरांस्तव सुतांस्ताडयामास भारत ।  शरैर्बहुविधैः संख्ये रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुतेजनैः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Then in that conflict, O king, the descendant of the Bharata race smote your other sons with diverse kinds of arrows furnished with golden wings and charged with great impetus.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संस्थाप्य समरे तान्यनीकानि सर्वशः ।  अभिमन्युप्रभृतयस्ते द्वादश महारथाः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Then those twelve mighty car-warrior including Abhimanyu and others, arranging their troops in proper order,

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषिता धर्मराजेन भीमसेनपदानुगाः ।  प्रतिजग्मुर्महाराज तव पुत्रान् महाबलान् ॥१४॥
verses.english: And being dispatched by the very virtuous king Yudhishthira to follow behind Bhima, encounter, O mighty monarch, your princely sons, all excellent car-warrior.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रथस्थांस्तान् शूरान् सूर्याग्निसमतेजसः ।  सर्वानेव महेष्वासान् भ्राजमानान् श्रिया वृतान् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Beholding those warriors on that chariots resemble the sun or the fire itself in effulgence, beholding all those fierce bow-men of burning effulgence and exceeding beauty,

verses.sanskrit: महाहवे दीप्यमानान् सुवर्णमुकुटोज्ज्वलान् ।  तत्यजुः समरे भीमं तव पुत्रा महाबलाः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Shine resplendent in that conflict being decorated with diadems of gold-your sons all endued with great strength abandoned fighting with Bhima. But the son of Kunti was unable to brook the sight of their leaving the combat alive.

verses.sanskrit: तान्नामृष्यत कौन्तेयो जीवमाना गता इति ।  अन्वीय च पुनः सर्वांस्तव पुत्रानपीडयत् ॥१७॥
अथाभिमन्युं समरे भीमसेनेन सङ्गतम् ।  पार्षतेन च संप्रेक्ष्य तव सैन्ये महारथाः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then Abhimanyu accomplished by Bhimasena, once more running after them afflicted your sons in battle. Thereupon the mighty car-warriors of your army including Duryodhana and others seeing Abhimanyu and Bhimasena joined with the son of Prishata in the midst of their own troops grasped their bows and carried along by fleet steeds rushed to the place where those heroes were stationed. Then, in that afternoon O monarch, there ensued a terrible fight between the mighty warriors of your army and those of the enemy, O Bharata. Then Abhimanyu, slaying the steeds of Vikarna in that terrible conflict,

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनप्रभृतयः प्रगृहीतशरासनाः ।  भृशमश्वैः प्रजवितैः प्रययुर्यत्र ते रथाः ॥१९॥
अपराह्णे महाराज प्रावर्तत महारणः ।  तावकानां च बलिनां परेषां चैव भारत ॥२०॥
अभिमन्युर्विकर्णस्य हयान् हत्वा महाहवे ।  अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समर्पयत्  ॥२१॥
हताश्वं रथमुत्सृज्य विकर्णस्तु महारथः ।  आरुरोह रथं राजंश्चित्रसेनस्य भारत ॥२२॥
verses.english: Pierced the latter with twenty five short shafts then that mighty car-warrior Vikarna, leaving his chariot of which the steeds were slain,

verses.sanskrit: स्थितावेकरथे तौ तु भ्रातरौ कुलवर्धनौ ।  आर्जुनिः शरजालेन च्छा‌दयामास भारत ॥२३॥
verses.english: Ascended, O king, the resplendent car of Chitrasena; them thus seated on the same chariot, namely those two brothers the perpetuator of Kuru's race.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च कार्ष्णिं पञ्चभिरायसैः ।  विव्याध तेन चाकम्पत् कार्ष्णिर्मेरुरिव स्थितः ॥२४॥
दुःशासनस्तु समरे केकयान् पञ्च मारिष ।  योधयामास राजेन्द्र तद‌द्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥२५॥
द्रौपदेया रणे क्रुद्धा दुर्योधनमवारयन् ।  शरैराशीविषाकारैः पुत्रं तव विशांपते ॥२६॥
पुत्रोऽपि तव दुर्धर्षो द्रौपद्यास्तनयान् रणे ।  सायकैर्निशितै राजन्नाजघान पृथक् पृथक् ॥२७॥
verses.english: Your son; and O monarch, every one them pierced him with three shafts each. Your invincible son, O monarch, in that conflict, pierced the sons of Draupadi separately with arrows of exceeding sharpness. Pierced with their arrows in return and bespattered with blood, he (Duryodhana) appeared highly beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: तैश्चापि विद्धः शुशुभे रुधिरेण समुक्षितः ।  गिरिः प्रस्त्रवणैर्यद्वद्गैरिकादिविमिश्रितैः ॥२८॥
भीष्मोऽपि समरे राजन् पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ।  कालयामास बलवान् पालः पशुगणानिव ॥२९॥
verses.english: Like a mountain washed with spring water mixed with red chalk. The highly powerful Bhishma also, O king, in that battle began to afflict the Pandava host like a herdsman belaboring his herd (with his cudgel). Thereupon, O ruler of men, the twang of Partha's Gandiva was heard, when he was engaged in slaughtering the right wing of your arıny. In that battle, headless trunks stood up in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गाण्डीवनिर्घोषः प्रादुरासीद्विशांपते ।  दक्षिणेन वरूथिन्याः पार्थस्यारीन् विनिघ्नतः ॥३०॥
उत्तस्थुः समरे तत्र कबन्धानि समन्ततः ।  कुरूणां चैव सैन्येषु पाण्डवानां च भारत ॥३१॥
शोणितोदं शरावर्तं गजद्वीपं हयोर्मिणम् ।  रथनौभिर्नरव्याघ्राः प्रतेरुः सैन्यसागरम् ॥३२॥
छिन्नहस्ता विकवचा विदेहाश्च नरोत्तमाः ।  दृश्यन्ते पतितास्तत्र शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥३३॥
निहतैर्मत्तमातङ्गैः शोणितौघपरिप्लुतैः ।  भूर्भाति भरतश्रेष्ठ पर्वतैराचिता यथा ॥३४॥
तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम तव तेषां च भारत ।  न तत्रासीत् पुमान् कश्चिद्यो युद्धं नाभिकाङ्क्षति ॥३५॥
एवं युयुधिरे वीराः प्रार्थयाना महद्यशः।  तावकाः पाण्डवैः सार्धमाकाङ्क्षन्तो जयं युधि ॥३६॥
verses.english: There was no man who was not in flamed with a desire for battle. Thus did those heroic warriors of your army fight on with those of the Pandava, desiring great renown and ardently longing for securing victory in battle.
